stages.title: SIBERIAN CLIMATE WORLD DISTRIBUTION

pills.text: LARGEST SINGLE TAIGA BAND, CONTINENTAL INTERIOR
BOREAL BELT FROM ROCKIES TO ATLANTIC COAST
SWEDEN AND FINLAND SHARE THE EUROPEAN TAIGA
NO LAND BROAD ENOUGH AT THESE LATITUDES
COOL TEMPERATE CONTINENTAL SIBERIAN/D CLIMATE DEVELOPS IN HIGH-LATITUDE INTERIORS

sequence: SIBERIA → largest single taiga band, continental interior
CANADA → boreal belt from Rockies to Atlantic coast
SCANDINAVIA → Sweden and Finland share the European taiga
SOUTHERN HEMISPHERE → absent: no land broad enough at these latitudes
MUST REMEMBER: Cool temperate continental Siberian/D climate develops in high-latitude interiors with long severe winters
